text:
Heather changed the vibe of my entire wedding day. This painting experience was gifted to us by my mother in law - and not only is it now a forever keepsake, but it was a TOTAL guest experience. Checking in on our painting throughout the night was so much fun. Our friends and family loved it so much. 

Working with Heather before our wedding was so fun - we hopped on the phone a week before because she wanted to completely understand my vision and hopes for our painting - and she delivered MORE THAN I COULD HAVE EVER IMAGINED. She was absolutely without a doubt our favorite vendor.

Heather was a joy to work with. Not only did she bring such incredible energy to our day, but she also went above and beyond to film so much iPhone content that I would have otherwise NEVER had of our wedding day. She (discreetly) filmed our vows, our grand entrance, my walk down the aisle, etc. I truly would have hired her just for this alone. I was so so soooo thankful to receive all of these (total surprise) from her the next day. This is something that makes Heather stand out amongst other vendors - this did not by any means fall under her promises to deliver but she did it anyway which I think speaks volumes to the person she is. She was so happy to just be apart of our day and capture it for us. 

If you are on the fence about a live painting experience - this is your sign, BOOK HER ASAP!!! 

We are forever Heathers biggest fans.

owner_reply.text: Shawna! You have been such a wonderful client to work with. I loved your joy and sweet spirit. I can totally see why so many people just love you!! After working your wedding I told my husband “I could see myself becoming great friends with Shawna”💗💗 Your wedding was perfect and I am beyond blessed to have painted for you and your guest!! I hope you enjoy your painting for a lifetime 🌸💗🌸

title: HEATHER CHANGED MY ENTIRE WEDDING DAY
